workarounds.note: the verse style says hyphenation: false although it changes nothing in 1.4.1, where ragged text is never hyphenated: it keeps the verse whole if ragged text starts to hyphenate
level 1's breakBefore (parity 'any') is restated because a headings object drops it
the front-matter heading styles restate breakBefore parity 'any' instead of inheriting level 1's, so a change to the poems' parity cannot put blank pages between the preliminary leaves
the roman numerals come from numberingTemplate '{1:I}' through {number}; {numberRoman} is filled only on part pages
the contents numerals are set at the titles' size (Italiana 11 pt), where they sit on the titles' baseline to within a pixel at 150 dpi; at 9 pt they rode visibly high
every design colour carries its hex beside its paletteId (col()), because design slots never read the palette
the title page's title takes lineHeight: 1, a multiple; a Dimension would silently drop the design's reserved height
every frontmatter value is quoted: the title page prints {title}, {subtitle} and {author}
the two ties in God’s Grandeur (the soil, bright wings.) sit in verse lines with no italic or bold, where U+00A0 holds; in a line with inline formatting it would still break

a paragraph style cannot indent a line and also hang its turnover (hangingIndent overrides firstLineIndent), so indentVerse() turns each pair of leading spaces into em spaces behind a word joiner and the verse style keeps only hangingIndent
